title: One token, two floors — Llama 2 70B decode on 2×H100
caption: Every generated token reads all 140 GB of weights once: the memory floor (20.9 ms) is 295.2× the compute floor (0.07 ms). Batch-one decode is bandwidth-bound — arithmetic investment at this batch buys nothing.

title: Independent failures at fleet scale
caption: The same failure rate that gives one GPU a ~5.7-year life gives a 1,024-accelerator pool a ~48.8-hour cluster MTBF — a failure about every two days.
